citation: Stevens, R. J., & Slavin, R. E. (1995). The cooperative elementary school: Effects on students' achievement, attitudes, and social relations. American Educational Research Journal, 32(2), 321-351. https://doi.org/10.3102/00028312032002321
design: QED (matched-comparison, school-level assignment); 2 treatment + 3 comparison elementary schools (5 schools total) in one suburban Maryland district; 21 treatment classes matched to 24 comparison classes on CAT Total Reading/Language/Math; grades 2-6 (Mixed); 2-year study. Cooperative Elementary School model = schoolwide cooperative learning (CIRC reading/language arts, TAI math, plus Jigsaw II/TGT/STAD) + mainstreaming + teacher peer coaching + collaborative teacher/admin planning + parent involvement. Comparison schools used business-as-usual basal/whole-class instruction. Full analyzed sample n=873 students (411 treatment, 462 comparison) with 2-year pretest data.
problems: Only 5 clusters (schools) with school-level assignment and just 2 treatment + 3 comparison schools -> very small cluster count; design effects cannot be properly accounted for. No ICC reported. The paper analyzed via HLM (students nested in classes nested in schools nested in treatment) and reports HLM-fitted (adjusted) means; authors describe HLM as 'analogous to a conservative class-level analysis' and note individual-level analyses showed MORE significant effects. The paper's effect size = (HLM-fitted mean_t - HLM-fitted mean_c) / control SD on grade-standardized z-scores; no impact-model SE is reported, so g variance is computed at the STUDENT level (not cluster-adjusted) and should be cluster-corrected centrally (Hedges 2007) once an ICC is assumed. All achievement outcomes are sub-1 SD z-scored, so pooled SD ~ control SD ~ 1 and computed g matches the paper's reported ES to two decimals. This is a QED (non-randomized matched schools), not an RCT.

effect_sizes.test_name: California Achievement Test (CAT) Form E - Reading Vocabulary subtest (grade-standardized z-scores)
effect_sizes.g_method: d = (HLM-fitted adjusted M_t - M_c)/s_pooled posttest SD = (0.10-(-0.11))/0.996 = 0.211; g = J*d, J=0.99914 (df=871); g_var = (n_t+n_c)/(n_t*n_c)+d^2/(2(n_t+n_c)) then J^2*Var(d). Student-level variance (not cluster-adjusted).
effect_sizes.page_ref: p.334 Table 1 (Year 2 Posttests, Read. voc.); narrative p.335
effect_sizes.notes: Significant t=3.04, p<.01 (HLM). Pretest covariate = CAT Total Reading. Paper-reported ES +.21 matches computed g. Full nonhandicapped+handicapped student sample.
